title: Mass ratio
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) correctly states the mass ratio as 8:1.

title: Charge signs
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) correctly identifies droplet a as negative and droplet b as positive.

title: Charge magnitude ratio
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) correctly states the ratio of the absolute charges as 4:1.

title: Terminal velocity force balance
description: Important: Applies Newton's first law to relate gravitational, drag, and electric forces when velocity is constant.

title: Drag force model application
description: Important: Correctly uses the given drag force model (f = k r v) to relate radius, speed, and force.

title: Radius from free-fall condition
description: Important: Derives the relationship between droplet radius and terminal velocity from the initial free-fall force balance (mg = k r v).

title: Direction analysis from velocity change
description: Optional: Correctly infers the direction of net force (acceleration) from the change in terminal velocity after the field is applied.

title: Incorrect drag force scaling
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly scales the drag force with velocity when applying the force balance with the electric field present (e.g., assuming f ∝ v without accounting for the changed radius).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Assigns the wrong sign to a charge based on an incorrect analysis of the electric force direction relative to gravity.

title: Algebraic or ratio error
description: Pitfall: Makes an algebraic mistake in solving the system of equations or calculating the final ratios (mass or charge).
